rv.q: The most urgent, albeit uncomfortable, work of the week is Jeremy Herrin 's searing production of Jennifer Haley's The Nether.
'TheNether' is a relentlessly the most difficult moral issues gripping, entertaining play.
Although the concept caught my interest, exploring these ideas was often poorly executed and failed to engage me in much of the story.

cn.t: Jennifer Haley's smart, chilling sci-fi thriller earns praise for its scintillating staging and highly pertinent exploration of virtual reality's dark possibilities, delivering a deeply disturbing yet excoriating examination of the internet's future.
